facts.raw_span: A 30-year-old male dairy farm worker presented with multiple painless nodules on the fingers of both hands for 1 month
Seven to ten days after the initial nodules appeared, he developed vesicles that ruptured and formed hemorrhagic crusts
he denied trauma or insect bites
his cow had similar lesions on its teats
3–4 firm, non-tender nodules with central hemorrhagic crusts and surrounding erythema were present on the proximal phalanges of both hands
mild tenderness and increased warmth along the medial right arm and forearm
